issues.description: Method addGuestStudents(int) has an inconsistent return type: the problem statement and UML specify `addGuestStudents(int): void`, but the reference solution implements `public boolean addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)`. This creates an API mismatch that can cause signature-based tests (and student implementations following the statement) to fail to match the expected method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the required API across statement/UML/template and solution. Preferred: change the solution to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` and remove boolean returns/validation feedback, or alternatively update the problem statement and UML to explicitly require a boolean return value and define its semantics.
